lesson_fields.title: Human Nutrition and Digestion
lesson_fields.summary: Humans need a balanced diet. Food is digested by enzymes into small molecules that are absorbed into the blood.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: L'humain a besoin d'une alimentation equilibree. Les aliments sont digeres par des enzymes en petites molecules absorbees dans le sang.
lesson_fields.content:
## A balanced diet

Carbohydrates give energy, proteins are for growth and repair, fats store energy. Vitamins, minerals, fibre and water are also needed.

## Enzymes

Carbohydrases break down carbohydrates, proteases break down proteins, and lipases break down fats. Absorption happens in the small intestine.
lesson_fields.content_fr:
## Une alimentation equilibree

Les glucides donnent de l'energie, les proteines servent a la croissance et a la reparation, les lipides stockent l'energie. Les vitamines, les mineraux, les fibres et l'eau sont aussi necessaires.

## Les enzymes

Les carbohydrases decomposent les glucides, les proteases decomposent les proteines, et les lipases decomposent les lipides. L'absorption se fait dans l'intestin grele.
objectives: Name the main nutrients and their functions
Name the three main types of digestive enzyme
Explain how the small intestine is adapted for absorption
objectives_fr: Nommer les principaux nutriments et leurs fonctions
Nommer les trois principaux types d'enzymes digestives
Expliquer comment l'intestin grele est adapte a l'absorption

steps.title: A balanced diet
steps.content: A balanced diet has the right amounts of carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water. Deficiency can cause health problems.
steps.content_fr: Une alimentation equilibree contient les bonnes quantites de glucides, proteines, lipides, vitamines, mineraux, fibres et eau. Une carence peut causer des problemes de sante.

question.text: Which nutrient is used for growth and repair?
question.text_fr: Quel nutriment sert a la croissance et a la reparation ?
question.explanation: Proteins are for growth and repair.
question.explanation_fr: Les proteines servent a la croissance et a la reparation.

hints.text_fr: Present dans la viande et les haricots.

steps.title: Enzymes at work
steps.content: Digestive enzymes break large molecules into small ones. Carbohydrases make sugars, proteases make amino acids, and lipases make fatty acids and glycerol.
steps.content_fr: Les enzymes digestives decomposent les grosses molecules en petites. Les carbohydrases donnent des sucres, les proteases donnent des acides amines, et les lipases donnent des acides gras et du glycerol.

steps.title: Absorption in the small intestine
steps.content: The small intestine is long with folded walls covered in villi. Villi give a large surface area, and each has a good blood supply, so small molecules are absorbed quickly.
steps.content_fr: L'intestin grele est long, avec des parois plissees couvertes de villosites. Les villosites donnent une grande surface, et chacune a une bonne vascularisation, donc les petites molecules sont absorbees vite.

steps.title: Check: villi
steps.content: Villi increase the surface area of the small intestine, which speeds up absorption of digested food into the blood.
steps.content_fr: Les villosites augmentent la surface de l'intestin grele, ce qui accelere l'absorption des aliments digeres dans le sang.

question.text: What is the main job of villi?
question.text_fr: Quel est le role principal des villosites ?
question.explanation: To increase surface area for absorption.

hints.text_fr: Plus de surface veut dire absorption plus rapide.

steps.title: What to keep
steps.content: A balanced diet gives carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water. Enzymes digest food; villi in the small intestine absorb the small molecules.
steps.content_fr: Une alimentation equilibree donne glucides, proteines, lipides, vitamines, mineraux, fibres et eau. Les enzymes digerent les aliments ; les villosites de l'intestin grele absorbent les petites molecules.
